env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd plain_support

logos run .
stdout '^relhelp-ok:plain-support-ok:42$'
cp stdout $WORK/plain-want.txt

logos eject -o out

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/plain-want.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ../..

-- relhelp/go.mod --
module example.com/relhelp

go 1.27

-- relhelp/relhelp.go --
package relhelp

func Help() string {
	return "relhelp-ok"
}

-- plain_support/go.mod --
module example.com/plain

go 1.27

require example.com/relhelp v1.0.0

replace example.com/relhelp v1.0.0 => ../relhelp

-- plain_support/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/relhelp"
	"logos/rt"
	"logos/sync"
)

func main() {
	var lk sync.Locked[string]
	lk.WithLock(func(s *string) {
		*s = "plain-support-ok"
	})
	val := ""
	lk.WithLock(func(s *string) {
		val = *s
	})
	num := 42
	frozen := rt.Freeze(&num)
	fmt.Printf("%s:%s:%d\n", relhelp.Help(), val, *frozen)
}
